about: I'm a Computer Science and Computer Information Systems double major at Grambling State University, building full-stack applications that actually ship — real clients, real users, real problems.

I work across the whole stack, but I'm drawn to the frontend: the intersection of engineering and design, where a good decision is both technically sound and visually right. I care about how things look and feel, not just whether they work.
Outside of engineering I paint, draw, read, and play chess. Those interests keep me curious and open to new ways of thinking — and they shape how I learn and build.
